rendered: In Fig. 2[1]a, the bacterium with the largest |ΔCD| for BA@L-HGNRs is P.aeruginosa[2]. Its light-pink L bar is the tallest in the panel. This is a reading of the bar height, not a value printed in the paper, and it comes to roughly[3] 192 mdeg[4]. The next largest is E. coli, and the bars get shorter along the axis until S. aureus, which has the smallest.[5]
